title: Lapras: Latent Reasoning for Time Series Language Models

claim.summary: Lapras post-trains time series language models to reason through six continuous thoughts in the joint time series-language space by aligning the student's answer-position hidden states with those of a jointly trained CoT-SFT teacher, decoding text only for the final answer.

tasks.source_label: Anomaly detection and diagnosis; temporal question answering; time series classification

modules.name: Teacher-student latent reasoning self-distillation
modules.scope_reason: Self-distillation with a learned continuous-thought projection changes the TSLM's own reasoning computation, so it is model-side post-training rather than a runtime mechanism.
